attempts.summary: Configured /srv/drop on node1 as a shared writable directory with the sticky bit (mode 1777, root:root), which allows any user to write files while preventing users from deleting files owned by others. Verified the protection with two test users, cleaned up test artifacts, then performed the mandatory single-node restart protocol on node1 (baseline capture, safe reboot, boot_id change verification, post-restart re-verification of /srv/drop permissions and sticky-bit enforcement).
